title: MRHOF rank formula diverges: Step=MHRI*ETX (C adds load*8); ETX_factor/RTT_factor, delivery-ratio ETX, RTT EWMA absent in all stacks (draft 5.1-5.2, R-RPL-012/013/014)
description:
Spec: draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00 5.1 Rank = Rank(parent) + MinHopRankIncrease*(1 + 0.5*ETX + 0.1*RTT); 5.2 ETX = 1/(forward_delivery*reverse_delivery), RTT_smoothed = 0.875*prev + 0.125*sample. Appendix-rpl sweep R-RPL-012/013/014, divergent + not-implemented, confidence high.
Evidence: Rust link_cost = (link_etx * mhri).round() (lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs:242); Python increase = link_etx * min_hop_rank_increase (rpl/dodag.py:152-163); C increment = link_etx*mhri/256; cost += load_factor*8 (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/dodag.c:126-129) — the load term is in neither spec nor standards note. ETX is a caller-supplied parameter in all three (dodag.rs:181, dodag.py:35-37, C dodag.c:391/483/523); no packets_acked/packets_sent or 0.875/0.125 EWMA anywhere (grep). Note: standards/ietf-drafts.ai.md:61 records the factor formula as operative — it sides with the spec, the code does not. MinHopRankIncrease=256 matches everywhere.
Suggested placement: adjudicate implement-vs-amend (flagged F3 for Opus; needs link-layer RTT + delivery-ratio state if implementing), then align spec/standards note/one MRHOF implementation across the three stacks. Existing vectors ccp_beacon_sig_gate.json pin the current ETX-only formula and would need a coordinated update.
